author: MomoandGemini
Zan (Zanidom)
name: ShowTix
short: Self-service shows (temporary voice channels) and guest-list threads.
description: Users open a show for a refundable deposit: a private voice channel under a configured category, tickets sold via per-user permissions, auto-closed after a configurable window (deposit forfeited). Also manages private guest-list threads. Based on ShowTix by MomoandGemini (https://github.com/MomotheWingedLemur/Red-Cogs), reworked by Zan.
install_msg: ShowTix installed! Admins: run `[p]showtixset category` and `[p]showtixset threadhome` to open the box office.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs of show owners and ticket holders while a show or guest-list thread exists, and deletes show records when the show closes.
